settings.heading: Creating Inspiring Learning Environments
settings.body_text:
School Decor equips schools, preschools and educational institutions with thoughtfully designed furniture, activity equipment, laboratories, outdoor play zones and complete campus infrastructure products.

Whether you are launching a new early-learning center or upgrading a multi-wing K-12 campus, our team helps you plan spaces that balance ergonomics, safety and daily longevity.

settings.script_lead: From floor plan to first bell
settings.heading: How We Build Your Campus

settings.title: Campus Walkthrough & Space Mapping
settings.description: We review your wing dimensions, student age groups, and classroom flow so every desk, shelf, and activity zone fits naturally without crowding.
settings.deliverables: 2D Scaled Room Layouts | Age-Group Sizing Matrix | Circulation & Safety Zones

settings.title: Custom Sizing, Colors & Finishes
settings.description: Select ergonomic seat heights, rounded birch laminates, powder-coat steel shades, and soft-play upholstery palettes aligned to your school identity.

settings.title: Institutional Manufacturing & QC
settings.description: Every unit is built for multi-year daily campus use with child-safe edge radii, non-toxic finishes, and heavy-gauge hardware checks.
